confirmedRules.gamePlayQueueOrder: Sort all objects; draw all non-alpha layer groups; then draw all alpha layer groups. Ordinary GS_PLAY does not alternate non-alpha and alpha per layer.
confirmedRules.layerGroup: Layers <=26 map directly; <=100 maps to27, <=200 to28, <=300 to29, <=400 to30, all higher to31.
confirmedRules.particleSortUnit: One CParticleEventSequence registered as an alpha object; not a particle, GLB child, or all instances sharing one template.
confirmedRules.particleSortKeys: Sequence Layer ascending, then sequence transformed object center distance to camera descending.
confirmedRules.particleSequenceCenter: Default object sphere center is zero. SetPosition moves the sequence matrix to m_Position, giving the emitter position as the normal sequence center.
confirmedRules.meshInternalOrder: Each sequence renders its particle list in list order. XRenderer repeats DrawCount inside that particle draw; mesh subset/child bounds do not reorder the sequence.
confirmedRules.quadInternalOrder: Each sequence groups by texture id in m_TextureMap order, then retains particle-list order within that texture group. The native dynamic vertex buffer draws that whole group with DrawCount.

confirmedWebMismatchBeforeV4: Babylon computed distance from every individual mesh SubMesh bound, and from a single quad template batch combining multiple emitter sequences. Correct finite bounds and template Layer alone do not restore native sequence draw-unit sorting.
